issues.on_page: COVID American Rescue Plan Fund Disbursements final budget 265,444 (trimmed p7)
issues.issue: ARPA disbursements 211,000 were split by function from the p4 fund column (111,000 general government + 100,000 public assistance, sums correctly), but the printed final budget 265,444 is not recorded on either piece (detail[36], detail[37]). The split itself is supported by the page.

Opioid settlement receipts are in 'other'. The printed label is 'Miscellaneous', so that is allowed, but the fund name shows what the money is. No existing category fits, so the user may want a settlement category.

issues.on_page: Local Assistance & Tribal Consistency Fund - Intergovernmental 50,000
issues.issue: Federal grants is inferred from the fund name (LATCF is a federal Treasury program). Every other 'Intergovernmental' line in the report is intergovernmental/state aid. Defensible, but the page does not print it as federal.
